messages:
maya: Uploaded the latest benchmark snapshot + two hero options to Drive. Need quick alignment: hero stat for PLG, enterprise gating, and the lead routing thresholds.

liam: For PLG keep it simple: median(128) latency as hero and a small cost-per-1M-tokens badge. Engineers like the perceived speed metric.

sophia: Agree. For enterprise headline we should call out p95 and mention SLA readiness. But don't gate everything  gate the whitepaper, not the blog CSVs.

drew: Lead routing proposal: form asks email, company, team_size, expected_monthly_tokens, deployment_interest. If expected_monthly_tokens > 5M OR deployment_interest includes "private" -> Enterprise lead. That lower token threshold will catch mid-market prospects.

ellen: +1 on lower threshold. Also add a checkbox "Require SLA" to immediately flag and ping AE Slack channel. Capture use_case (chat/embeddings) too.

liam: Visuals: hero card + delta chip showing relative median vs baseline (e.g., "+28% faster (median)"). Blog: include latency CDF and a scatter with cost-per-1M on the y-axis so marketing can show business impact.

sophia: Legal-friendly copy: "Up to 1.7x lower per-token cost on short chat sequences; see paper for test harness and caveats." Also call out the baseline model name in the methodology card.

drew: Interactive idea: tiny sequence-length slider (64/128/512) on the blog that swaps the scatter points and updates the waterfall breakdown. Frontend needs a small JSON endpoint with CSVs + CORS.

maya: Nice. For analytics, track bench_page_view, whitepaper_request, try_api_from_bench. Add lead props: team_size_bucket and expected_tokens_bucket.

ellen: HubSpot flow: I'll build the form and automation. Rule: Enterprise leads -> create contact+company, tag "bench-enterprise", webhook AE Slack, and assign to AE queue. Non-enterprise -> product nurture.

hook-bot: [system] artifact uploaded: /shared/marketing/bench/exports/bench-snapshot-2026-03-25.csv by maya at 2026-03-25T10:12:00Z

maya: Great. Decision summary: PLG hero = median(128); enterprise highlight = p95 + SLA CTA; gate whitepaper, not raw CSVs; route leads with expected_monthly_tokens>5M or private interest to AE. Will finalize copy and visuals by EOD Monday.
